title: WISP2/CCN5 revealed as a potential diagnostic biomarker for endometriosis based on machine learning and single-cell transcriptomic analysis.
authors: Dou, Sheng; Ling, Shaohua; Nong, Weihua; Wei, Bixiao; Huang, Yuehua; Li, Guangjing; Wang, Rong; Qin, Haimei
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用机器学习和单细胞转录组分析筛选子宫内膜异位症诊断生物标志物WISP2/CCN5，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Endometriosis is a prevalent gynecological disease characterized by the ectopic growth of functional endometrial tissue outside the uterine cavity, affecting millions of women worldwide. Currently, the definitive diagnosis relies on invasive laparoscopy (the gold standard), with an average diagnostic delay of 7-10 years from symptom onset. Non-invasive biomarkers from blood or endometrial samples could enable early screening and reduce diagnostic time. Emerging technologies like single-cell sequencing and transcriptomics offer promising approaches for identifying highly specific biomarkers, advancing endometriosis research into the precision medicine era. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Using three machine learning algorithms, we selected four hub genes, among which WISP2/CCN5 was validated as a potential diagnostic biomarker. We discovered higher-than-normal gene expression of WISP2/CCN5 in the eutopic endometrium, and substantially higher expression in the ectopic endometrium compared with that in the eutopic endometrium. RESULTS: Finally, through cell communication analysis, we found that elevated WISP2/CCN5 expression in stem cells within ectopic lesions may be mediated by the mitogen-activated protein kinase and Wnt signaling pathways, acting downstream of the fibroblast growth factor pathway. CONCLUSIONS: The transition of endometrial tissue from normal to eutopic, and ultimately to ectopic, was found to coincide with progressively increased expression of WISP2/CCN5, which may serve as a biomarker of endometriosis.
abstract_zh: 目的：子宫内膜异位症是一种常见的妇科疾病，其特征是功能性子宫内膜组织在子宫腔外异位生长，影响全球数百万女性。目前，确诊依赖于侵入性腹腔镜检查（金标准），从症状出现到确诊平均延迟7-10年。来自血液或子宫内膜样本的非侵入性生物标志物可实现早期筛查并缩短诊断时间。单细胞测序和转录组学等新兴技术为识别高特异性生物标志物提供了有前景的方法，推动子宫内膜异位症研究进入精准医学时代。材料与方法：利用三种机器学习算法，我们筛选出四个核心基因，其中WISP2/CCN5被验证为潜在的诊断生物标志物。我们发现在位子宫内膜中WISP2/CCN5的基因表达高于正常水平，而异位子宫内膜中的表达显著高于在位子宫内膜。结果：最终，通过细胞通讯分析，我们发现异位病灶内干细胞中WISP2/CCN5表达的升高可能由丝裂原活化蛋白激酶和Wnt信号通路介导，作用于成纤维细胞生长因子通路的下游。结论：子宫内膜组织从正常到在位、最终到异位的转变，与WISP2/CCN5表达的逐步增加相一致，这可能作为子宫内膜异位症的生物标志物。
